question: Given: x + (1)/(x) = -2, then determine the value of x⁶ + (1)/(x⁶) - 3 (x⁴ + (1)/(x⁴)) + 4 (x² + (1)/(x²))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When an algebraic equation is given as x + 1/x = −2, the only possible real value for x is −1.

For any even power, xeveⁿ = (−1)eveⁿ = 1.

Substitute x = −1 directly into the required expression:

⇒ (1 + 1) − 3 × (1 + 1) + 4 × (1 + 1)

⇒ 2 − 6 + 8 = 4

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x + 1/x = −2

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²

**Calculations:**

⇒ (x² + 1) / x = −2

⇒ x² + 1 = −2x

⇒ x² + 2x + 1 = 0

⇒ (x + 1)² = 0

⇒ x = −1

Now, substitute x = −1 into the given expression:

Value = x⁶ + 1/x⁶ − 3(x⁴ + 1/x⁴) + 4(x² + 1/x²)

⇒ (−1)⁶ + 1/(−1)⁶ − 3 × [(−1)⁴ + 1/(−1)⁴] + 4 × [(−1)² + 1/(−1)²]

⇒ (1 + 1/1) − 3 × (1 + 1/1) + 4 × (1 + 1/1)

⇒ (1 + 1) − 3 × (1 + 1) + 4 × (1 + 1)

⇒ 2 − 3 × 2 + 4 × 2

⇒ 2 − 6 + 8

⇒ 4

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Standard Algebraic Case (x = 1)

If x + 1/x = 2, then the only real solution is x = 1. Consequently, xⁿ + 1/xⁿ = 2 for any real number n.

Standard Algebraic Case (x = −1)

If x + 1/x = −2, then the only real solution is x = −1. The value of xⁿ + 1/xⁿ will be 2 if n is even, and −2 if n is odd.

Algebraic Identities involving Squares and Cubes

x² + 1/x² = (x + 1/x)² − 2
x³ + 1/x³ = (x + 1/x)³ − 3(x + 1/x)
